newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bradesco still a neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bradesco still a neutral.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said it has maintained its neutral rating for Brazil's largest private bank, Bradesco, but has lowered its forecasts for the company's 1996 and 1997 earnings.
-- The brokerage, citing the bank's weaker-than-expected third-quarter results, said it reduced 1996 earnings estimates on Bradesco preferred to $0.76 per lot of 1,000 shares from $0.80.
-- It also reduced its 1997 forecast to $0.96 from $1.01 per thousand shares, it said.

-- "When we initiated coverage of Bradesco on May 30, 1996, the bank was trading at $7.77 and we felt its price already reflected its strong fundamentals while trading at a premium over Itau and Unibanco" banks, Bear Stearns said.
-- The price has dropped in recent weeks and remains under pressure, it added.
-- The brokerage said it wants to see details on bank operating expenses and Bradesco's ability to maintain short-term profitability in its insurance division before it changes its rating.
-- Bradesco preferred closed Monday at 7.45 reais while its voting common ended at 6.90 reais on thre Sao Paulo bourse.
